announcements.headline: Investee company, WeShop Launches its Community-Owned Shopping App in the U.S.
announcements.insight: WeShop launches its U.S. app, following the September launch date announcement. This operational step follows the recent CEO appointment.

announcements.headline: Investee company, WeShop to Launch in the U.S. November 16
announcements.insight: WeShop launches in the U.S. following its CEO appointment and Russell 3000 inclusion. This expansion may drive growth for investee WeCap.

announcements.headline: Investee company, WeShop added to Russell 3000 Index
announcements.insight: WeShop joins the Russell 3000 Index. This follows the appointment of Maria Weaver as CEO in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Investee company, WeShop Appoints Maria Weaver as Chief Executive Officer
announcements.insight: WeCap Plc reports an appointment at one of its investee companies. Shareholders should monitor how this leadership change affects WeCap's investment returns.
